person_note: The novel has sustained narration in two persons: Nora Sinclair's sections use third person, while FBI agent John O'Hara narrates his sections in first person. The supplied quote belongs to Nora's third-person strand and agrees with the authorized opening. Multiple independent whole-book structural descriptions establish the O'Hara first-person strand and the recurring switch, so isolated speech or thought is not driving the ALTERNATING label. No credible structural conflict was found; the main coverage limitation is that the supplied quote samples only Nora's strand.
